name: steward
description: A little less to carry. Personal goals, useful next steps, and context you can return to.

interface.shortDescription: Make room for what matters. Take the next step.
interface.longDescription: Bring a goal, a loose end, or a week that needs untangling. Steward helps you check in, make progress, and adjust, with readable memory and optional Apple app context. You choose the connections and approve consequential actions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $steward to help me get started or pick up where I left off.
